column1: # How is a LoRA adapter actually addressed? Measured against real vLLM + real EPP.
# vLLM registers each adapter under two BODY-level names (--lora-modules): the bare
# name and the fully qualified one. It never sees an HTTP header. The endpoint
# picker also reads the body - it answers 400 "model not found in request body"
# when the body has no model, whatever the header says.
# So X-Gateway-Model-Name selects nothing. It exists only so an HTTPRoute can match
# on the requested model, because Gateway API cannot route on a body.

column6: EPP: model not found in request body
